name: agy-auto-context
description: Automatic selection context for Antigravity (agy): writes the current editor selection range (path + 1-based lines, no text) to ~/.cache/agy-auto-context for the bundled agy PreInvocation hook, shows the selected line range in the status bar, and shows 'N lines selected' in a collapsible one-row view under the Antigravity chat.

commands.title: agy auto context: Select Status Bar Format

agyAutoContext.statusBarFormat.description: Format of the agy auto context status bar indicator.
